location: Setup, step 6; Playing the Game; 2-Player Games
firstPlayerRule: Whoever explored an island most recently receives the first-player marker and places meeples first.
clarifications: Everyone rolls their own meeples before the placement phase. Placement then proceeds clockwise from the first player.
With two players, place the Automaton's meeples before the human players take their placement turns.
